_comment: Risk-appetite position sizing config (src/pricer/sizing). Replaces the flat ~$50mm placeholder sizes in portfolio.json with sizes derived from three risk-appetite mandates. All coefficients are ASSUMPTIONS — tune to the desk's actual capital, funding and house views. capital_base is the NAV/equity backing the book; VaR budgets are 1-day 99% as a fraction of it.
_default_profile_comment: The book in src/pricer/portfolio/portfolio.json is sized to this profile (see its sizing_basis). Promoted from 'aggressive' to 'core' (the Aggressive-Balanced rebalance, docs/design/portfolio_rebalance_review.md) on 2026-07-26; golden PVs rebaselined to the core default. Sizing always sizes the base book, so re-running never compounds.
_stress_constraint_comment: Stress-loss sizing constraint (docs/specs/scenario-decision-impact.md, decided 2026-10-17): a profile's worst scenario loss at `tier` may not exceed var_multiple x its daily VaR budget (balanced 6%, core 12%, aggressive 15%, risky 30% of capital_base). Used by src/scenariogen/decision_impact_runner (analysis only); sizing_runner and the published book variants do not apply it.

expected_returns._comment: Hybrid μ engine. Equities use β·ERP(+growth tilt); everything else uses carry/theta from trade economics. funding_rate ≈ short SOFR at the valuation date.

_hedge_comment: Macro/issuer hedges sized at hedge_scale x current (absolute), thinned by appetite. SMH short (TRADE_6) is treated as directional — it is the short leg of the semis relative-value structure, not a macro hedge.
_market_neutral_pairs_comment: N5 dispersion pairs sized as a unit: the short leg's notional is pinned to short_ratio x the long leg's, overriding the return-tilt (which floors the negative-carry short leg). short_ratio = beta_long/beta_short gives a beta-neutral pair (net-zero market exposure).

market_neutral_pairs.note: INTC (long, beta 1.05) / AMD (short, beta 1.65) semis dispersion; 1.05/1.65 = 0.636 -> beta-neutral

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Diversified, risk parity across the directional book, full hedges. Low 1% daily VaR budget; ~1-1.5x gross.

core.label: Core (Aggressive-Balanced)
core.description: Retuned aggressive (portfolio_rebalance_review.md): keeps the growth tilt but restores most of the downside/rate/issuer hedges, caps single-name concentration, and takes the negative-skew carry (CDX-sell, JPY) off the notional cap. Moderate 2% daily VaR budget; ~2.5-3x gross. risk_share_cap bounds the REALIZED net-book risk share of any single name (concentration_cap only bounds the intended directional budget, which left MU ~24% of net risk).

aggressive.label: Aggressive Growth
aggressive.description: Return-tilted toward high risk-adjusted-return names, partial hedges. Elevated 2.5% daily VaR budget; ~3x gross.

risky.label: Highly Leveraged / Risky
risky.description: Risk concentrated in the top Sharpe names, minimal hedges. High 5% daily VaR budget; ~6x gross.
